newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil shrugs off crude's tumble.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil shrugs off crude's tumble.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil prices were firm on Tuesday in tight markets despite new straight-run offers out of Russia, traders said.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges traded at $121, $122 and $122.50 fob ARA but the offer later slipped to $120 for prompt refinery material, as futures markets scuttled lower.
High sulphur cargo markets were very thin, with little product heard on offer except for a piece for early/mid November out of Scandinavia. Utility demand was patchy.

Three New E-4 cargoes out of Russia, all loading before November 10, were weighing on the market. Sellers were talking $4 a tonne over the mean/mean/mean of published quotes, while buyers said +$2.50 was more reasonable.
M-100 cargoes were still heard on offer. One, on the vessel Lami, was heard offered at mean/means +$3.
Low sulphur markets were very dull. Offers were heard at $131 cif Italy. November low sulphur swaps were pegged at $121 fob NWE.
